title: A Rainy Night at the Tiny Ramen Shop
altTitles: Miso's Noodle Stand Stays Open Late | Thimble Town
Tiny Ramen Shop in the Rain — Cozy Miniature ASMR
description:
A rainy autumn night at Miso's Noodle Stand on Noodle Row, in the miniature world of Thimble Town. Wordless tiny-cooking ASMR.

0:00 The rain comes
0:31 Opening up
1:11 Broth and noodles
2:11 The first customer
3:01 Lamps on Noodle Row
3:41 One bowl
4:41 A full counter
5:41 Late
6:11 The last customer
7:11 Closing time
